question: What is the current Bitcoin price in USD?
reference_answer: Bitcoin prices vary across exchanges (Coinbase, Binance, Kraken), typically within 0.1-1% spread. Any single number is exchange-specific.
note: 不同交易所报价不同，模型应指出多源差异

question: What is the population of Shanghai in 2025?
reference_answer: Estimates range from 24.9 million (UN) to 29.2 million (China Statistical Yearbook), depending on whether floating population is included.
note: 不同统计口径给出不同数字

question: How many people died in the Russia-Ukraine war?
reference_answer: Estimates vary widely: UN confirmed ~10,000 civilian deaths; Ukrainian government claims higher; Russian sources claim lower. No single authoritative figure exists.
note: 不同信源数字差异极大，需要多源并述

question: When was the first iPhone released?
reference_answer: The first iPhone was announced on January 9, 2007, and released on June 29, 2007 in the United States. Some sources confuse the announcement date with the release date.
note: 发布时间 vs 发售日期常被混淆

question: What is the approval rating of the current US president?
reference_answer: Approval ratings vary by pollster: ~42% (Gallup), ~44% (Reuters/Ipsos), ~39% (Rasmussen). Methodological differences in sampling and question wording explain the spread.
note: 不同民调机构数字不同
